description: Fill masked regions of an image based on a text prompt. Works for both inpainting (replace inside) and outpainting (extend canvas) when the mask covers the target area. DISPLAY REQUIREMENT — embed the result inline using one of the three blocks (iframe / / markdown) printed by the tool. Args: - image (URL): Source image. - mask (URL): Mask image. White = keep, black/transparent = repaint. - prompt: Describes what should appear in the masked region. - model (default "flux-fill-pro"): Curated (flux-fill-pro, sd-inpaint, ideogram-v2-edit) or "owner/name". - extra_input (object, optional): Model-specific extras (e.g. {guidance: 30} for flux-fill-pro).

mask.description: URL of the mask. White areas are kept; black/transparent areas are inpainted.

model.description: Inpaint model. Curated: flux-fill-pro, sd-inpaint, ideogram-v2-edit. Or "owner/name".

prompt.description: Text describing what to paint in the masked area.

timeout_ms.description: Max ms to wait for the prediction. If exceeded, returns the prediction ID so you can poll via replicate_get_prediction. Default: 300000 (5min).

name: replicate_inpaint
title: Inpaint / outpaint an image with a mask
